preflight.json.hypothesis: A point reference can only propose where to inspect: determine whether existing current-frame retained Foam appearance support supplies an observed perimeter near partial surviving correspondence, before designing a reobservation rule. Use the same complete frame plans, not only the newly judged right-hand subset.
preflight.json.operation: Unchanged isolated Foam owner capture ON/OFF; exact full perimeter of every retained label; measure all live point center memberships and distances to all fully visible unit faces with every exact tie. Preserve mask/crop faces separately. No snapping, selected component, dominant cluster, lower-perimeter substitution or physical output.
preflight.json.decision_and_abstention: This is a prerequisite, not a physical selector. If current support omits the real boundary or joins it to structure, this representation alone cannot supply reobservation authority. Even a unique nearby face remains physical UNRESOLVED; no nearest-face acceptance threshold is fit. The human reply does not select track IDs or pixel truth.
preflight.json.difference: Prior point/edge lookup lacked side membership; this probes the unchanged existing region perimeter at the new partial-correspondence case while preserving its already known contamination. It does not repeat the full support representation implementation or claim material from connectivity.
controls: capture ON/OFF all non-diagnostic fields equal
every face independently enumerated from labels and visibility
all old tracked frame plans including positive initialization and known rim
frozen prior public/texture control results remain opposing; no new labels
preflight.json.visibility: effective AND NOT glare; diagnostic support recovered through glare is censored. Point membership is descriptive; full LK stencil visibility remains unestablished. Zero is outside retained support, not physical air/Oil.
preflight.json.scope: isolated current Foam capture, no Oil/temporal/sequence/application detector execution; no settings, source, recipe, formal truth or initial reference changes
preflight.json.stop_rule: Do not union, fill, retune whiteness, alter cleanup or snap to a chosen branch if current support fails. No per-frame manual rescue or formal Oil/Foam ownership follows.
